Lia (support): hey team—customer on enterprise tier reporting intermittent 400s + embedding dim mismatch + occasional null vectors when using our embeddings endpoint with batching enabled. reported around 11:02 UTC. example error: "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 128". correlation_id=cr_9f2b
Maria (customer): repro steps they gave: send 12 concurrent requests with varying text lengths, max_batch_size=32, dynamic_batching=true. ~10% of requests fail with dim mismatch. happens only when they ramp traffic.
Lia (support): they say setting max_batch_size=1 stops the problem (but ruins throughput). they also tried pinning model to rwd-embed-v2-medium -> same behaviour.
Devon (eng-runtime): can you paste a sanitized request/response pair and the raw logs? also what's the model and quantization?
Maria (customer): paste: `POST /v1/embeddings
{"model":"rwd-embed-v2-medium","input":["short", "a very long paragraph..."],"batching":{"max_batch_size":32}}`
Maria (customer): response (one of the failures): `400 Bad Request { "error": "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 128", "request_id":"req-abc123" }`
Lia (support): attached a small client script they used (fast loop, no sleep). sounds like dynamic batcher is fusing requests with different model variants or padding incorrectly.
Devon (eng-runtime): quick hypothesis: when dynamic batching picks a smaller kernel path for short sequences it might be returning a different vector length due to an accidental branch where quantized path uses 128-dim staging buffer. i've seen a similar bug during quantization refactor. need logs from the batcher microservice: batcher.log and the kernel path chosen events. @Alex can you pull last 2 hours?
Alex (sre): pulling logs for that customer account now. seeing a pattern: at t=11:02:07 the batcher created a combined batch of 24 requests. batcher emitted "kernel_route=quantized_fast" for that batch. downstream runtime printed "output_dim=128" then an exporter step attempted to reconcile with model profile expecting 1536 -> error.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0902-emb-dim-mismatch assigned to eng-runtime.
Devon (eng-runtime): ok that confirms a routing mismatch. immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) advise customer to set max_batch_size to a power-of-two lower value (eg 8) as a temporary guard; 2) set dynamic_batching=false for them; 3) deploy a hotfix to batcher routing to avoid quantized_fast path for rwd-embed-v2-medium until we patch.
Lia (support): Maria, can you try max_batch_size=8 and dynamic_batching=false? will follow up with more permanent fix.
Maria (customer): tried max_batch_size=8 + dynamic_batching=false — seems to eliminate errors in 30 minutes of testing. latency increased slightly but acceptable. :thumbsup:
Devon (eng-runtime): root cause theory: during recent kernel selection optimization we introduced a fallback path that reinterprets buffer dims for quantized kernels. fix is twofold: (A) ensure kernel path always sets output_dim metadata before exporter runs, (B) add schema guard in batcher to drop/route requests with incompatible model profiles. I'll open PR with tests that replay the failing trace.
Devon (eng-runtime): repro script I'm using: 
```
# repro.sh
for i in {1..1000}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-v2-medium","input":["short","long long long text..."],"batching":{"max_batch_size":32}}' &
done
wait
```
Devon (eng-runtime): run that with `ulimit -n` high and observe logs. i'll attach unit test harness that simulates the quantized kernel route.
Alex (sre): ops note: rolling back the quantized_fast kernel to cold path in the 3 affected regions reduced incidents. we have a canary in us-west-2 running today. no customer-facing deploy yet.
Lia (support): next steps for support: 1) inform affected customers (we have list) to toggle dynamic_batching=false or set max_batch_size <=8; 2) offer a credit for errors; 3) keep thread updated.
Maria (customer): thanks — we'll keep dynamic batching off for now. please let me know when fixed so we can re-enable.
Devon (eng-runtime): action items: DEV-1245 create patch + tests (assigned to Devon). DEV-1246 add schema guard in batcher (assigned to Alex). DEV-1247 release notes + customer comms (Lia).
Alex (sre): logging enhancement: add `batch_output_dim` field to batcher telemetry so we can alert when it disagrees with model_profile.expected_dim.
Lia (support): thumbs up. adding to incident. :eyes:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0902 updated — mitigation in progress.
Devon (eng-runtime): i'll post PR link once ready and ping here for validation.
Lia (support): closing loop with customer: Maria, i will DM you when we have a stable patch and schedule a quick test window. thanks for the repro and patience.
Maria (customer): appreciated. :rocket:
